title: Kyverno — Community dashboard (adapted)
description: The Kyverno community Grafana dashboard ported to this lab's ImageValidatingPolicy metrics and Grafana 13.

options.content:
### Kyverno: community dashboard, adapted to this lab
Port of the Kyverno community dashboard (written for Grafana 8 and the legacy `ClusterPolicy`/`Policy` metrics `kyverno_policy_*`). This lab runs one **ImageValidatingPolicy** (`tenant-images-signed`), so policy results and execution times come from `kyverno_image_validating_policy_*`. Panels about mutate/generate rules, background scans and policy-change counters have no data source here and were replaced. Results exclude the smoke test's probe namespace `admission-probes`. Metrics reference: [kyverno.io/docs/monitoring](https://kyverno.io/docs/monitoring/).

panels.title: Policy evaluation failure rate (24 h)
panels.description: Share of tenant policy evaluations that failed in the last 24 h (upstream: 'Rule Execution Failure Rate').

panels.title: Policies evaluated (24 h)
panels.description: Distinct policies that evaluated at least one resource in the last 24 h (upstream counted ClusterPolicies from kyverno_policy_rule_info_total, which ImageValidatingPolicies do not export).

panels.title: Enforcing (Deny)
panels.description: Policies evaluated in the last 24 h whose validation action is Deny.

panels.title: Audit only
panels.description: Policies evaluated in the last 24 h that only audit (do not block).

panels.title: Image checks (24 h)
panels.description: Tenant image-policy evaluations in the last 24 h (upstream: 'Validate Rules', a rule count; here an activity count).

panels.title: Failed checks (24 h)
panels.description: Tenant image-policy evaluations that failed in the last 24 h.

panels.title: Kyverno version
panels.description: kyverno_info per spoke (upstream had mutate/generate rule counts; this lab has neither rule type).

panels.title: Admission denial rate (24 h)
panels.description: Share of tenant admission requests Kyverno denied in the last 24 h (upstream: 'Background Scans Failure Rate'; this lab runs no background scans).

panels.title: Admission results (per evaluation)
panels.description: Image-policy results of admission requests, per 5 minutes.

panels.title: Results by namespace
panels.description: Image-policy results per tenant namespace, per 5 minutes (upstream: background-scan results).

panels.title: Policy failures (by policy)
panels.description: Failed evaluations per policy, per 5 minutes.

panels.title: Admission results (per policy)
panels.description: Results per policy and outcome, per 5 minutes.

panels.title: Results by spoke
panels.description: Results per spoke and outcome, per 5 minutes.

panels.title: Policies seen in the selected range
panels.description: One row per policy and spoke, from the labels of its evaluations (ImageValidatingPolicies export no info metric): validation mode, background mode, evaluations and failures in the range.

targets.expr: round(sum by (cluster, policy_name, policy_validation_mode, policy_background_mode) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{resource_namespace!="admission-probes", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])))

round(sum by (cluster, policy_name, policy_validation_mode, policy_background_mode) (increase(kyverno_image_validating_policy_results_total{result="fail", resource_namespace!="admission-probes", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Average policy execution time
panels.description: Average time to evaluate the image policy (signature and attestation checks), per policy.

panels.title: Average execution time by spoke
panels.description: The same, per spoke.

panels.title: Overall average execution time
panels.description: Lifetime average of all policy executions since the Kyverno pods started.

panels.title: Executions (range)
panels.description: Policy executions in the selected range (all namespaces, including the smoke-test probes).

panels.title: Average admission review time (by operation)
panels.description: Average Kyverno admission review time per operation.

panels.title: Average admission review time (by resource kind)
panels.description: Average Kyverno admission review time per resource kind.

panels.title: Admission requests (range)
panels.description: Admission requests Kyverno reviewed in the selected range (all namespaces).

panels.title: Overall average admission review time
panels.description: Lifetime average since the Kyverno pods started.

panels.title: Controller and Webhook Activity (replaces 'Policy Changes': no such metric for ImageValidatingPolicies)
Controller reconciles
panels.description: Reconcile operations per Kyverno controller, per 5 minutes.

panels.title: Webhook server requests (by endpoint)
panels.description: Calls from the API server to Kyverno's webhook endpoints, per 5 minutes: /ivpol/validate and /ivpol/mutate serve tenant-images-signed. Kyverno v1.19 records no HTTP status code, so webhook errors are not visible as a metric here.

panels.title: Webhook calls (24 h)
panels.description: Calls to Kyverno's webhook server in the last 24 h (no status code is recorded, so this is volume, not errors).

panels.title: Admission requests (by operation)
panels.description: Admission requests per operation, per 5 minutes.

panels.title: Admission requests (by resource kind)
panels.description: Admission requests per resource kind, per 5 minutes.

panels.title: Total admission requests (24 h)
panels.description: Admission requests Kyverno reviewed in the last 24 h (all namespaces).
